cellPurpose: Load a raw workpiece to a CNC fixture, unload the completed workpiece, place it in an inspection nest, then transfer it to the finished tray. The candidate design supplies the robot and gripper only.

candidateDesignEnvelope.name: permitted-operating-envelope
candidateDesignEnvelope.rule: All candidate solid geometry, swept volumes, cable/utility routes, and carried workpiece envelopes shall remain within this envelope except during explicitly declared service access outside automated operation.

keepOutVolumes.name: CNC machine body
keepOutVolumes.exception: The tool and carried workpiece may enter the declared fixture approach corridor only.

keepOutVolumes.name: CNC fixture approach corridor
keepOutVolumes.rule: Only the gripper, permitted workpiece envelope, and a candidate-declared compliant alignment feature may enter. All other candidate structure shall remain outside.

keepOutVolumes.name: operator access zone
keepOutVolumes.rule: No candidate geometry or swept payload envelope may enter during automatic operation.

keepOutVolumes.name: overhead guarding beam
keepOutVolumes.rule: No candidate geometry or swept payload envelope may enter.

stations.name: raw-parts tray
stations.note: Workpiece fixture does not clamp the part. Candidate shall account for allowable approach direction and gripper clearance.

stations.name: CNC load/unload fixture
stations.note: The path to the fixture must honor the approach axis and keep-out corridor.

stations.name: inspection nest
stations.note: The cell has only passive lead-ins; the candidate must plan alignment and placement compliance.

stations.name: finished-parts tray
stations.note: Finished part cosmetic surfaces must remain protected.

requiredProcessPoses.toleranceIntent: Tray position tolerance only; candidate must declare final grasp approach and allowed workpiece orientation.
Approach axis within 2 degrees; all other geometry must remain outside KOV-002.
Clearance re-established before movement outside corridor.
Vertical approach with candidate-declared alignment/compliance strategy.
Clearance re-established before movement outside nest envelope.
Tray position tolerance only; candidate must protect cosmetic surfaces.

commonEvidenceMotionLimits.policy: These are fixed comparative evidence inputs, not a supplied dynamic host, controller, collision solver, or automatic qualification model. Candidates use them in declared motion/load reasoning; reviewers apply inputs/common-evaluation-method.json consistently across architectures.

maximumTcpSpeed.uncertainty: No dynamic-host correlation is claimed; calibration boundary recorded in VAL-004.

maximumTcpAcceleration.uncertainty: No dynamic-host correlation is claimed; calibration boundary recorded in VAL-004.

maximumTcpJerk.uncertainty: No dynamic-host correlation is claimed; calibration boundary recorded in VAL-004.

provenance.basis: Benchmark-author representative machine-tending geometry, fixed for v1.0 to force integrated reach, insertion, clearance, service, and safety trade-offs.
provenance.applicability: All public demonstration and fixed-anchor v1.0 calculations. Private instances may perturb only categories committed in inputs/instance-bank-commitment.json.
provenance.uncertainty: No physical as-built cell has been surveyed. Coordinate values are fixed input data with ±2 mm authoring tolerance except where an interface tolerance is stated.
